text.p: Exemplar - (built 1990) 122,760 dwt 12.5 on 38 plus 3.5 del Cape Passero end Aug trip via Nouadhibou redel Antwerp $12,500 darly - Kleimar.

Hai Kang - (built 1993) 70,155 dwt 14 on 31 plus 2 del Tomakomai about 23 Aug trip Longbeach r/v $9,500 daily Showa.
Scenery Sea - (built 1991) 69,358 dwt 13.5 on 27 del U.S. Gulf 20/31 Aug trip redel China $12,500 daily plus $240,000 bb CNR.
Evgenia - (built 1981) 67,250 dwt 13 on 33 plus 1.8 del Newcastle early Sept trip and redel Taiwan $8,100 daily plus $130,000 bb HMM.

Avra - (built 1982) 64,854 dwt 13 on 42 plus 3.5 del Newcastle 20 Aug/4 Sep trip and redel Taiwan $8,100 daily plus $130,000 bb HMM.
Alpha Gemini - (built 1985) 52,298 dwt 13.5 on 31 plus 1 del U.S. Gulf 29 Aug/5 Sept trip and redel Far East $11,900 daily plus $200,000 bb Pan Ocean.
